title: DECISION: handle_enable extracted as pure function for unit testability
description: The ENABLE command logic (latch check, newly-enabled list construction, RFC 5161 §3 idempotency rule) is extracted into pub(crate) fn handle_enable(cap: &str, imap4rev2_enabled: &mut bool) -> bool rather than being inlined into the dispatch match arm. This allows the four RFC 5161 unit tests (sets latch, idempotent, unknown cap ignored, state-guard predicate) to exercise the logic directly without spinning up a real Server, TcpStream, or TLS session. Alternative rejected: testing via the full session loop would require a live connection for each case, making the tests slower and coupling them to I/O concerns irrelevant to the ENABLE semantics.
